changeSet.author: Bhoward
changeSet.comment: Adding new locked column for settings
changeSet.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Setting]','Locked') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Setting] ADD [Locked] bit constraint DF_Setting_Locked default(0) not null END
changeSet.rollback: IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Setting]','Locked') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Setting] DROP DF_Setting_Locked ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Setting] DROP COLUMN [Locked] END

changeSet.author: Bhoward
changeSet.comment: Updating the new locked column to 1 for some settings
changeSet.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Setting]','Locked') IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE [dbo].[setting] set Locked = 1 WHERE ID in (4,15,16,25,26,27,55,56,68) END
changeSet.rollback: IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Setting]','Locked') IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE [dbo].[setting] set Locked = 0 END
